name: How much does GEO marketing cost for a home service business?

mainEntity.name: How much does GEO marketing cost for a home service business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of GEO marketing for a home service business varies widely based on the scope of services, the competitiveness of your market, and the number of service areas you target. Basic packages might start from a few hundred dollars per month, while more comprehensive strategies involving extensive content creation, paid local ads, and advanced optimization could range into several thousands. A custom quote is typically provided after assessing your specific business needs and marketing goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO marketing costs vary by service scope, market competitiveness, and target areas, typically ranging from hundreds to thousands per month.
